Messages.Author: Stubby
Messages.Body:
is this tzmicise card stackable as it is non unique or are vamps only
allowed one retainer each? if so what happens if you heidleberg
retainers onto another vampire who already has a retainer?

just asking

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>is this tzmicise card stackable as it is non unique or are vamps only
>allowed one retainer each? if so what happens if you heidleberg
>retainers onto another vampire who already has a retainer?

Yes, Reverants are stackable. And no, there is no restriction on the number of
retainers allowed on a minion, unless the card says otherwise. The Heidleberg
question is moot since you can have infinitely many retainers (as long as you
have enough cards).

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct, as per the rules: "there is no limit to the number of
retainers a minion can have." [6.1.4]
